claims.text: Neil Armstrong, commander of Apollo 11, was the first person to walk on the Moon, in July 1969.
Buzz Aldrin stepped onto the Moon after Armstrong, Michael Collins never walked on the Moon, and Yuri Gagarin was the first person in space, in 1961, and never went to the Moon.
Buzz Aldrin stepped onto the lunar surface about 20 minutes after Neil Armstrong.
During the Moon walk, Michael Collins stayed in lunar orbit aboard the Apollo command module, named Columbia.
